completed_slice: Established a fail-closed identifier-origin evidence contract so semantic matches, suffix collisions, automation prose, and reconstructed history cannot be promoted to originating provenance.
durable_memory: Artifact identity and artifact meaning are separate claims. Meaning may be supported by multiple sources; identity origin requires an immutable source that explicitly assigns the exact identifier and agrees on namespace, owner, semantic role, and temporal precedence.

claim_classes.observed: The continuity queue requires the originating source that assigned M-004, M-005, and M-006, not merely files containing similar labels or concepts.
claim_classes.inferred: A missing explicit-assignment gate permits false continuity through semantic substitution.
claim_classes.proposed: Validate every provenance resolution against operations/continuity/contracts/identifier-origin-evidence.schema.json before changing a node to resolved.
claim_classes.superseded: Textual identifier occurrence or semantic similarity alone establishes artifact origin.
claim_classes.unresolved: M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unlocated pending exhaustive authenticated branch and history coverage and an immutable explicit-assignment source.

verified_properties: resolved requires an accepted candidate with explicit identifier assignment
unlocated source status requires unresolved claim status
candidate evaluation records namespace, owner, semantic role, and temporal precedence

safe_next_action: Create a small validator and falsification suite for the schema, then run an authenticated exhaustive ref and reachable-history traversal and evaluate each candidate source without reconstructing missing identifiers.
